subject: MAP: evaluation & close playbook — deployment mode and region selection
messages:
From: Cara Nguyen <cara@mednova.health>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kick-off: hosting & region decision for MedNova POC

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday — the procurement and platform teams asked me to kick off a short MAP so we can get to a deployment decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and lock a go/no-go region for our POC. Attached is our baseline MAP spreadsheet (MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx) with internal milestones and compliance checkpoints.

Key asks from our side:
- High-level cost delta for Dedicated at 250 RPS vs Hosted baseline (monthly estimate)
- SOC 2 evidence and KMS/key management flow for Private deployments
- Rough timeline to a POC in US vs APAC (we prefer US-East but need APAC readiness by Q3)

Can your team provide a draft MAP and suggested evaluation plan by EOD tomorrow? We want to present to the executive committee next week.

Thanks,
Cara Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations
MedNova Health

Attachments: MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara@mednova.health>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:23:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: hosting & region decision for MedNova POC

Hi Cara — thanks for the clear asks and the MAP. I've sketched a Redwood-facing MAP and evaluation plan attached (Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx) that aligns milestones to your spreadsheet and adds decision criteria for the hosting mode + region. High-level notes:

1) Decision criteria (to be weighted with your team):
   - Latency SLO: 95th percentile goal (ms) per region
   - Cost per 1M tokens / throughput bucket (Hosted vs Dedicated)
   - Data residency / compliance: whether customer-managed KMS / on-prem storage required
   - Operational runway: time-to-rollout, required engineering effort (weeks)

2) Recommended evaluation plan (short form):
   - Week 0: Finalize MAP & sign mutual milestone doc (1-week sign-off window)
   - Week 1: Hosted POC (validate latency & correctness, prefix caching benefits)
   - Week 2–3: Dedicated smoke (reserved capacity test, throughput stability)
   - Week 4: Private infra review only if required by compliance (separate cadence)

3) Region recommendation: propose US-East for initial POC to hit exec timeline; APAC staging targeted for Q3 once we confirm model quant and token economics.

I've looped Priyom for pricing & model ops considerations and Marcus for capacity numbers. Priyom/Marcus — can you review the draft MAP and add line items for pricing assumptions and capacity (respectively) by COB today?

Next step for MedNova: quick confirmation of the decision criteria weighting (latency vs cost vs compliance). If we have that, we can produce a 1-page scoring matrix for the exec meeting.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cara Nguyen <cara@mednova.health>
Date: 2027-04-01T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: hosting & region decision for MedNova POC

Lauren / Marcus — quick pricing and ops notes inline.

On pricing:
- Hosted baseline estimate (MedNova typical mixed gen/embedding workload at 250 RPS): ~$18k/month (token-driven; includes prefix caching benefits).
- Dedicated (reserved) for predictable 250 RPS continuous: requires ~4 x A100-style GPUs equivalent; committed monthly ~ $42k/month (includes autoscale headroom).
- Private (on-prem/VPC) cost is highly variable — we should price as professional services + infra; include an NRE and support premium.

Risk notes for Private:
- Lead time 8–12 weeks for certs, KMS integration, and procurement; this likely misses your exec timeline.
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide our SOC2 summary and sysadmin contact; customer may still request an attestation or gap plan. I attached SOC2_summary.pdf for the initial review.

Model ops / eval notes:
- Start with Hosted to validate correctness, then move to Dedicated if token economics/p95 latency require it. Private only if data residency enforces it.
- Quantization/FP16 options can reduce Dedicated GPU count by ~20% for non-LLM-1 workloads — we'll include that sensitivity in Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx.

Action items: I will drop detailed pricing assumptions into the MAP and upload by EOD. Marcus — can you add a short capacity estimate (working with Ops) and a recommended staging region?

— Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cara Nguyen <cara@mednova.health>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: hosting & region decision for MedNova POC

Quick capacity & region readout — short version.

- For a sustained 250 RPS with 1.2k token/session average: estimate peak concurrent tokens ~300k. Dedicated pool sizing: recommend a 4-GPU dedicated pool (NVIDIA A100 80GB equivalency) with a 20% headroom buffer.
- US-East (primary) gives lowest latency for your user base in NA and is where our warm pool sits; APAC will have +40–70ms delta unless we deploy a regional pool.
- Deployment cadence: Hosted POC (US-East) can be live within 48–72 hours after credentialing. Dedicated staging in US-East: ~10 business days to provision and validate. Private: expect 6–10 weeks depending on procurement and network access.

I've attached a short capacity sketch (capacity_estimate_q2.pdf) with latency projections and autoscale knobs. Given MedNova's exec timeline, US-East hosted POC is the conservative choice to hit next-week deliverables; Dedicated is reasonable for post-POC production if cost/latency trade-offs justify it.

Marcus Lin
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_estimate_q2.pdf (application/pdf)

> On 2027-04-01T14:05:00Z Priyom Das wrote:
> > Start with Hosted to validate correctness, then move to Dedicated if token economics/p95 latency require it. Private only if data residency enforces it.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara@mednova.health>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T16:48:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: hosting & region decision for MedNova POC

Cara — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Summary and proposed next steps (this will be the mutual action plan we send to execs):

Summary (recommendation):
- Immediate path: Hosted POC in US-East (48–72 hours to stand up) to validate latency and correctness. This meets your exec timeline.
- Contingency: Move to Dedicated in US-East post-POC if 95th percentile latency or token economics require reserved capacity (~10 business days to provision).
- Private deployment only if MedNova compliance requires customer-managed KMS or on-prem storage; expect 6–10 week lead time and professional services.

Deliverables we will provide by EOD tomorrow if you confirm the decision criteria weighting:
- 1-page scoring matrix (latency vs cost vs compliance)
- MAP with milestone dates & owners (finalized mutual action plan ready for signature)
- Pricing appendix (Hosted vs Dedicated monthly estimates + assumptions)
- SOC2 summary & KMS integration notes (attached)

Action items:
- MedNova: confirm weighting for the scoring matrix and preferred initial region (default US-East) — reply to this thread by 2027-04-03T12:00:00Z.
- Redwood: finalize MAP + scoring matrix and push a HubSpot deal update (see link) and DocuSign envelope for the mutual milestone doc.

Links & artifacts: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4592 | Draft MAP/attachments attached. DocuSign link will be issued after you confirm the weighting.

If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute prep call tomorrow morning to walk the scoring matrix before your exec meeting. Proposed time: 2027-04-03T09:00:00Z (30 min).

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | lauren@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
